title: ClotheKraft
client: ClotheKraft (A Unit of Magically Creative Innovation)
description: A full-featured fashion e-commerce store built with Laravel for ClotheKraft, a New Delhi based clothing brand known for premium T-shirts, jeans and co-ord sets. The platform offers a smooth shopping experience with category-based browsing, product variants by size and colour, wishlist and cart, secure checkout, and an admin panel for managing products, orders and promotions.
features: Shop by category (Regular Fit, Oversized, Polo T-Shirts, Jeans, Co-ord Sets)
Product variants with size and colour selection
Quick add to cart and wishlist
Customer accounts with order history and saved addresses
Admin dashboard for products, orders and inventory

title: Fragdiction
description: A luxury perfume e-commerce store built with Next.js for Fragdiction, selling authentic niche, designer and Middle Eastern fragrances. The platform features brand and fragrance house browsing, bestseller collections, partially used (decant level) listings, a perfume request service for hard-to-find scents, and a journal section, all optimised for speed and SEO.
features: Browse by fragrance house type (Niche, Designer, Middle Eastern)
Brand showcase for houses like Amouage, Tom Ford, Acqua di Parma and Al Haramain
Most Loved and Bestseller product collections
Pre-owned bottle listings with fill level details
Perfume request form for sourcing unavailable fragrances
FAQ on authenticity, shipping and returns

title: UltraSonic
description: A hearing aid e-commerce store built with Laravel for UltraSonic, selling Olive Air hearing aids, Bluetooth hearing aids and advanced hearing aid devices. The platform combines a clean, dark storefront with product search, wishlist and cart, multi-country support, customer accounts, and a blog and FAQ section to help customers choose the right hearing solution.
features: Product catalog for hearing aids and accessories
Hero slider highlighting featured products like Olive Air
Secure checkout and payment gateway integration
Admin panel for products, orders and content

title: SkyHighTrip
description: A comprehensive travel booking platform built with PHP that integrates with the Amadeus API to provide real-time flight and hotel booking services. The platform offers seamless search, comparison, and booking capabilities for flights and accommodations with live pricing and availability data.
features: Real-time flight search using Amadeus API

title: YoungSietar
description: A professional business website showcasing corporate services, team information, and client portfolio. Designed with clean, modern aesthetics to establish strong brand presence.

title: Progressive Graphics Employee Attendance Management System
description: A comprehensive employee attendance management system built with Laravel, featuring clock in/out functionality, employee chat communication, event calendar, task management, and export capabilities. Designed to streamline employee time tracking and improve workplace communication and productivity.
features: Admin dashboard with employee clock in/out management
Employee chat system using Chatify for seamless communication
Interactive event calendar for company-wide events
Task assignment system with admin controls

title: XRDigitech
description: A WordPress-powered website for an AR/VR and software solutions company showcasing immersive projects, 3D/interactive demos, enterprise software services, and industry use cases. Built to highlight spatial computing capabilities, custom software development, case studies, and lead capture with performant media handling.
features: Portfolio of AR/VR projects with rich media
Service pages and industry use cases

title: FreshEarth
description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform built on Shopify specializing in premium organic fruits, nuts, and seeds. The website features an intuitive shopping experience with detailed product catalogs, nutritional information, and sustainable packaging options. Designed to promote healthy living through natural, organic products sourced from trusted suppliers.

title: IconTravels
description: A WordPress-based travel agency website showcasing luxury travel experiences, destinations, and services. Built as a contact-focused platform where customers can browse travel packages and contact the agency directly for bookings and personalized vacation planning.

title: Gurudwara Sadh Sangat
description: A comprehensive WordPress website for Gurudwara Sadh Sangat, designed to serve the spiritual community with information about religious services, events, community programs, and spiritual guidance. The website provides an intuitive interface for devotees to access gurudwara information, view schedules, and stay connected with the community.
features: Homepage with spiritual design and welcoming interface
Event calendar for religious ceremonies and programs
Information about daily services and timings
Photo galleries of events and ceremonies
Contact forms for inquiries and donations
SEO optimization for local search visibility

title: Abacus Mental Mathematics Academy
description: A professional WordPress website for Abacus Mental Mathematics Academy, designed to showcase abacus courses, training programs, and educational services. The website provides an engaging platform for parents and students to learn about mental mathematics training, view course details, enroll in programs, and track student progress.
features: Interactive homepage showcasing abacus benefits and courses
Course catalog with detailed program descriptions
Testimonials and success stories from students
Event calendar for workshops and competitions
Contact forms for inquiries and consultations
Blog section for educational tips and updates
Mobile responsive design for all devices
Payment gateway integration for course fees

title: CashFlow Summit
description: A modern, dynamic event website built with ReactJS for CashFlow Summit, designed to showcase financial education events, speaker lineups, and registration information. The platform provides an engaging user experience with smooth animations, responsive design, and interactive features to promote financial literacy and business growth events.
features: Interactive event landing page with modern design

title: SFB Cookies
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform built with Laravel and Vite for SFB Cookies, specializing in premium handcrafted cookies and baked goods. The platform offers a seamless shopping experience with real-time inventory management, secure payment processing, order tracking, and an intuitive admin dashboard for managing products, orders, and customer relationships.
features: Product catalog with detailed descriptions and images
Secure checkout and payment gateway integration
User account management and order history
Email notifications for orders and updates
Fast page loading with Vite optimization

title: Wealth Matrix Group
description: A professional tax advisory and financial consulting platform built with Next.js for Wealth Matrix Group, providing comprehensive tax planning, wealth management, and financial advisory services for clients in Canada and USA. The platform features client portals, appointment scheduling, document management, and secure communication channels for personalized tax consultation.
features: Professional landing page with service showcase
Resource library with tax guides and articles
Blog section for tax updates and news

title: Excelerate Tax Advisory
description: A modern Next.js-powered tax advisory website for Excelerate Tax Advisory, specializing in cross-border tax planning and compliance services for individuals and businesses in Canada and USA. The platform provides expert tax consultation, filing services, and financial planning with a focus on maximizing returns and ensuring regulatory compliance.
features: Interactive service pages for tax solutions
